correctness.rationale: In update-order coordinates the predecessor-used equations give H F=J with H unit triangular. The determinant of tH+J has only diagonal and full-cycle permutations, yielding Q. In the cokernel of B(t)^T, both t and (t+1) are units since Q(0)=Q(1)=1; row relations make the module cyclic, so minimal polynomial equals the degree-n characteristic Q even with repeated factors. Kernel of t^m+1 on F2[t]/(Q) has dimension deg gcd. Any mixed precedence orientation is an acyclic orientation of the cycle and admits a topological sort. Independent bitwise sweep and polynomial determinant calculations matched all 150 schedules for n=3,4,5.
